title: Check the links in my arts log
objective: I can verify a link between my arts learning and an actual record.
success_criteria: I can distinguish a claim from its supporting record.
I can check that a locator opens to the matching work.
I can identify what remains unverified.

scheme_row.outcome_paraphrased: Organise the arts log with genuine records, checked links and clear actions for any gaps.

lesson_sequence: Lesson 1 links an arts account to actual work and checks its locator through shared practice and a checkpoint. Lesson 2 recalls the checked record, shares with an agreed listener, refines the account and files genuine replies while retaining open actions.
layout_reference: Week 8 layout; accepted Week 6 paired edition
award_status: Practice evidence only. No completion decision, encounter, public event or completed response is pre-filled.
picture_colours: Picture colours. Navy is used for symbols, lines and numbers. White is the page and the eye space. Amber, cream, mint green and pale blue are cue box fills. Grey and silver are used in the mark. Black is used for the mark corners. Words, numbers and shapes give the meaning. Green · Ready, Amber · Help, Red · Pause.
marking_formula: in the same colour, on the same page or usual mode
